versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00337 The RTE shall use the OS Application Identifier as the Instance Id to enable the de- veloper to identify in which runtime section of the RTE the error occurs. This Instance ID is even unique across multi cores and so implicitly allows the development error to be traced to a specific core.
